gapbs_bfs_s.description: GAPBS bfs: direction-optimizing breadth-first search from one source per trial, on kron_g12.sg, a Kronecker graph that the build wrote with GAPBS's own generator and fixed seed. Size: the graph scale and -n, the number of trials. Each trial starts from the next source of GAPBS's fixed-seed picker. -v checks the last trial against a serial reference and exits 1 on a mismatch. -a prints that trial's result summary.

bzip2_s.description: libbzip2 1.0.8 compresses 4 KiB of generated text at block size 1 (100 kB blocks), decompresses it and compares. Size: the first argument, in KiB. Exits 0 only if the bytes came back. Prints the FNV-1a hash of the input and of the compressed stream.

bzip2.description: libbzip2 1.0.8 compresses 112 KiB of generated text at block size 1 (100 kB blocks), decompresses it and compares. Size: the first argument, in KiB. Exits 0 only if the bytes came back. Prints the FNV-1a hash of the input and of the compressed stream.

zstd_s.description: libzstd 1.5.7 compresses 17 KiB of generated text at level 12, decompresses it and compares. Size: the first argument, in KiB. Keep it above 16 and at most 128, where level 12 uses the btlazy2 match finder (lib/compress/clevels.h). Exits 0 only if the bytes came back. Prints the FNV-1a hash of the input and of the compressed stream.

zstd.description: libzstd 1.5.7 compresses 128 KiB of generated text at level 12, decompresses it and compares. Size: the first argument, in KiB. Keep it above 16 and at most 128, where level 12 uses the btlazy2 match finder (lib/compress/clevels.h). Exits 0 only if the bytes came back. Prints the FNV-1a hash of the input and of the compressed stream.

lua_binary_trees_s.description: Lua 5.4.9 runs binary_trees.lua, binary-trees: allocates and walks many small trees, so table allocation, recursion and the garbage collector dominate. Size: N is the depth of the deepest tree; the work doubles per step. The script checks its own result, and lua_bench exits 0 only if it passed.

lua_fannkuch_s.description: Lua 5.4.9 runs fannkuch_redux.lua, fannkuch-redux: counts pancake flips over every permutation, the most branch-bound Lua script here. Size: N is the permutation length (work grows as N!) and M repeats the run. The script checks its own result, and lua_bench exits 0 only if it passed.

lua_nbody_s.description: Lua 5.4.9 runs nbody.lua, n-body: integrates the orbits of the outer planets, floating-point arithmetic on table fields with regular loops. Size: N is the number of time steps. The script checks its own result, and lua_bench exits 0 only if it passed.

lua_spectral_norm_s.description: Lua 5.4.9 runs spectral_norm.lua, spectral-norm: power iteration on an N by N matrix, with a Lua call for every element. Size: N is the matrix size; the work grows as N squared. The script checks its own result, and lua_bench exits 0 only if it passed.

lua_word_freq_s.description: Lua 5.4.9 runs word_freq.lua, word_freq: generates text, counts words in string-keyed tables and sorts them with a comparator. Size: N is the number of lines of text. The script checks its own result, and lua_bench exits 0 only if it passed.

sqlite_s.description: SQLite 3.53.4 builds an order database of 80 lines in memory from recursive CTEs, then joins, groups, sorts, updates and deletes. Size: the second argument, the number of order lines. bench.sql compares pairs of answers, and sqlite_bench exits 0 only if all agree.

sqlite.description: SQLite 3.53.4 builds an order database of 1500 lines in memory from recursive CTEs, then joins, groups, sorts, updates and deletes. Size: the second argument, the number of order lines. bench.sql compares pairs of answers, and sqlite_bench exits 0 only if all agree.
